nodes.name: Dom 01
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Three Doms enter the community hall carrying one uncovered soup pot.{pause}The pot is wide, the doorway is narrow, and nobody packed a lid.{pause}Lead Dom calls this a delivery challenge, not a planning failure.{pause}Second Dom carries bowls stacked high enough to hide his mono-eye.{pause}Third Dom has the bread and keeps counting it whenever nerves strike.{pause}Somewhere upstairs, forty hungry volunteers are setting out spoons.{pause}A handwritten schedule gives lunch exactly one hour to become a fond memory.

nodes.name: Dom 02
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Steady hover. Do not salute while holding lunch.{pause}Second Dom salutes anyway, then catches three bowls with one elbow.{pause}Third Dom reports that the bread remains calm but emotionally distant.{pause}The soup rocks once, like a tiny red sea considering bad weather.{pause}All three Doms lean right until the pot settles in the middle.{pause}Lead Dom writes NO SALUTING on a napkin and calls it procedure.{pause}Second Dom asks whether procedures written on napkins survive tomato weather.

nodes.name: Dom 03
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The invitation says Room 3B, past the lobby and up one floor.{pause}The lobby map lists 3A, 3C, and a closet named Three Maybe.{pause}A paper arrow points left, while a painted arrow points straight.{pause}Someone has added SOUP in pencil with a hopeful question mark.{pause}Lead Dom studies every mark as if the building were a battlefield.{pause}Second Dom asks if a battlefield usually smells this much like celery.{pause}Third Dom circles every uncertain arrow and accidentally draws a tomato.

nodes.name: Dom 04
nodes.speaker: Third Dom
nodes.dialogue: Inventory check: bowls, bread, ladle, soup, emergency crackers.{pause}Second Dom admits the emergency crackers became regular crackers.{pause}Lead Dom asks whether the ladle can serve as a temporary lid.{pause}It can, if nobody minds a lid shaped mostly like empty space.{pause}A warm tomato bubble rises and pops with unreasonable confidence.{pause}The three Doms take one respectful step away from the splash zone.{pause}The pot answers with a smaller bubble that sounds suspiciously like a challenge.

nodes.name: Dom 05
nodes.speaker: Custodian
nodes.dialogue: You boys taking that upstairs? Elevator is thinking about retirement.{pause}The custodian taps the button. It lights, sighs, and turns itself off.{pause}Lead Dom asks for the safest route that does not include surrender.{pause}The custodian points toward a ramp used for rolling folding chairs.{pause}He also points toward stairs built by an enemy of level liquids.{pause}Then he accepts a cracker as a consulting fee and wishes them luck.{pause}His advice is free, but his cracker renewal rate is surprisingly firm.

nodes.name: Dom 06
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Mission rule one: the soup arrives warmer than the room.{pause}Rule two: every volunteer receives one recognizable vegetable.{pause}Rule three: no Dom becomes part of the soup, even symbolically.{pause}Second Dom asks whether a boot near the broth counts as symbolic.{pause}Lead Dom moves the boot, updates the rule, and checks the time.{pause}They have twenty minutes before lunch becomes an awkward condiment.

nodes.name: Dom 07
nodes.speaker: Third Dom
nodes.dialogue: My aunt helps at these drives. Lunch is usually the forgotten job.{pause}She says hot food makes a long shift feel like someone noticed.{pause}For a moment, even Second Dom stops balancing bowls on his helmet.{pause}Lead Dom straightens the napkin label tied around the pot handle.{pause}It reads FOR EVERYONE in letters blurred by one tomato spot.{pause}The route is still silly, but the delivery suddenly matters a little.{pause}Third Dom remembers her once finishing a winter shift with cold soup still sealed in its delivery{pause}tin.{pause}The kitchen had written the correct address.{pause}But nobody had written which door stayed unlocked after six.{pause}His aunt shared crackers with the night crew and laughed about it, yet she remembered the missing{pause}warmth for years.{pause}Lead Dom adds a fourth rule to the napkin: a meal is delivered only when somebody can actually eat{pause}it.

nodes.name: Dom 08
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: They pause beside a trophy case while the hall grows quiet.{pause}Old plaques honor chess teams, gardeners, and one loud ferret.{pause}The ferret plaque says PERSISTENCE IS MOSTLY SHOWING UP AGAIN.{pause}Second Dom salutes the ferret, safely, with both hands empty.{pause}Lead Dom allows it because even strict procedures need exceptions.{pause}Then the title tune returns softly as three shadows cross the glass.

nodes.name: Dom 09
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: At the ramp, a cart loaded with tablecloths blocks the entrance.{pause}The cart has one square wheel and a sign reading DO NOT IMPROVISE.{pause}Lead Dom quietly turns the sign around before anyone gets ideas.{pause}Second Dom already has an idea involving bread as wheel chocks.{pause}Third Dom points out that guests prefer unflattened bread.{pause}They agree to move the cart using patience, elbows, and no lunch.

nodes.name: Dom 10
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: The cart shifts six inches and reveals a sharp turn in the ramp.{pause}The pot will fit, but three Doms cannot walk beside it at once.{pause}One plan uses careful handoffs, each Dom guarding a corner.{pause}The other uses their famous formation and a lot of confidence.{pause}Second Dom votes for whichever plan includes a dramatic name.{pause}Lead Dom asks the team to choose before the soup chooses for them.

nodes.name: Dom A1
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Single-file handoff. Pot, pivot, hover, stop. Mostly stop.{pause}Lead Dom takes the front handle and calls every step aloud.{pause}Second Dom receives the pot at the turn with surprising gentleness.{pause}Third Dom keeps the bread below the dangerous ladle arc.{pause}For eight whole seconds, the system works like a sensible system.{pause}Then a folding chair rolls downhill and requests right of way.

nodes.name: Dom A2
nodes.speaker: Second Dom
nodes.dialogue: Chair at six o'clock. It appears committed to the route.{pause}Lead Dom cannot release the pot, so Third Dom deploys the bread.{pause}One sturdy loaf stops the wheel without becoming much flatter.{pause}Second Dom catches the chair and seats it beside the trophy case.{pause}He gives it a stern talk about traffic rules and unattended motion.{pause}The chair offers no apology, but it stops causing problems.

nodes.name: Dom A3
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: At the landing, the handoff rhythm becomes almost musical.{pause}Pot, pivot, hover, stop. Bowls, bread, ladle, check.{pause}A passing child claps to the beat and adds a fourth word: soup.{pause}Soon all three Doms whisper the pattern whenever the liquid tilts.{pause}The red surface calms as if it learned the choreography too.{pause}Lead Dom pretends not to be proud of a soup-based marching song.

nodes.name: Dom A4
nodes.speaker: Third Dom
nodes.dialogue: Handoff complete. Spillage is below one respectable spoonful.{pause}They divide that spoonful among the emergency crackers as tribute.{pause}Lead Dom ties the NO SALUTING napkin around the saved bread loaf.{pause}Second Dom names it Wheel Stopper First Class and salutes.{pause}The careful route took longer, but every bowl remains stacked.{pause}They rejoin the corridor with proof that boring plans can be brave.

nodes.name: Dom B1
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Jet Stream Delivery. Three abreast, synchronized ladles, steady soup.{pause}The formation enters the ramp with more confidence than clearance.{pause}Second Dom calls the left wall friendly after bouncing off it once.{pause}Third Dom rotates the bread basket like a shield for nearby ankles.{pause}Lead Dom counts three, two, one, turn. The pot turns beautifully.{pause}Unfortunately, the rest of the formation continues straight ahead.

nodes.name: Dom B2
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Three Doms become a slow pinwheel around a surprised pot.{pause}The soup rises on one side and reveals a carrot shaped like a star.{pause}Second Dom calls it a good omen, though nobody asked for omens.{pause}Lead Dom orders tiny steps until their boots face one direction.{pause}Third Dom backs into the DO NOT IMPROVISE sign and reads it aloud.{pause}They agree the sign arrived too late to contribute anything.

nodes.name: Dom B3
nodes.speaker: Second Dom
nodes.dialogue: Correction: shoulder in, bowl stack high, dignity optional.{pause}He passes the ladle overhead, making room near the inside wall.{pause}Third Dom tucks the bread beneath his arm and guards the edge.{pause}Lead Dom guides the pot through one careful breath at a time.{pause}The famous attack becomes a great catering maneuver.{pause}A child in the lobby asks whether they perform at weddings.

nodes.name: Dom B4
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Ramp cleared. Add catering applications to the future discussion.{pause}A single crouton escaped and rests on Second Dom's shoulder.{pause}He keeps it there as a medal for advanced formation control.{pause}Third Dom counts the bread twice and finds every loaf present.{pause}The route was loud, ridiculous, and faster than predicted.{pause}They rejoin the corridor with a new rule: turns require knees.

nodes.name: Dom 11
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: One floor up, every door is decorated for a different club.{pause}Room 3A has paper flowers. Room 3C has socks on a clothesline.{pause}Three Maybe has a handwritten star and the smell of fresh coffee.{pause}The invitation card gained a wet corner during the climb.{pause}Its last letter might be B, 8, or a very tired snowman.{pause}The main tune returns as Lead Dom unfolds the building map again.

nodes.name: Dom 12
nodes.speaker: Volunteer
nodes.dialogue: Soup? Great. We have been expecting soup for almost an hour.{pause}A yellow-apron volunteer appears from Room 3C with four bowls.{pause}Lead Dom asks the event name before releasing the handles.{pause}The volunteer says Laundry Club, then admits they expected cookies.{pause}Second Dom thinks soup and cookies could become a bold menu.{pause}Third Dom notices forty more voices farther down the hall.

nodes.name: Dom 13
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The aroma travels ahead and recruits a quiet procession.{pause}Gardeners, chess players, and two people with puppet heads follow.{pause}Nobody knows where Room 3B is, but everyone knows where lunch is.{pause}Lead Dom asks the crowd to keep a safe distance from the broth.{pause}The crowd takes one very small and hopeful step back.{pause}Second Dom whispers that they may have become a soup parade.{pause}The chess captain offers a score sheet for tracking bowls.{pause}Meanwhile, the gardeners volunteer a clean watering can for refills.{pause}Lead Dom rejects the watering can, accepts the score sheet, and appoints Second Dom Acting Marshal{pause}of Spoons.{pause}Third Dom tears the bread inventory into numbered claim tickets so the quiet volunteers will not be{pause}skipped by the cheerful crowd.{pause}The parade becomes a system: one line for bowls, one for returns, and one tiny lane for{pause}anyone carrying puppet heads.

nodes.name: Dom 14
nodes.speaker: Third Dom
nodes.dialogue: Bread report: the parade has strong sandwich intentions.{pause}He counts the loaves and estimates one polite slice per volunteer.{pause}Lead Dom says the food belongs to the service crew in 3B.{pause}A gardener replies that the service drive uses every club.{pause}The invitation named one room, but the work filled the hall.{pause}The delivery problem has quietly become a fairness problem.

nodes.name: Dom 15
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: We can serve everyone if the bowls return in waves.{pause}Second Dom organizes a bowl relay using the ramp rhythm.{pause}Third Dom stations bread at the center and guards equal slices.{pause}The crowd forms a patient line past every mystery door.{pause}For five minutes, three little robots run a serious soup desk.{pause}Not one salute occurs while a filled bowl is in either hand.

nodes.name: Dom 16
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: My first delivery was a lunch tray to the wrong hangar.{pause}Nobody ate it because I was too embarrassed to knock twice.{pause}Third Dom says arriving wrong is fixable; leaving hungry is not.{pause}Second Dom offers the crouton medal as proof of growth.{pause}The title melody returns while Lead Dom studies the blurred card.{pause}This time, he decides, they will ask before retreating.{pause}Lead Dom turns the damp invitation over and finds a phone number beneath the tomato stain.{pause}The lobby has no signal, so he asks each club captain what work their people came to finish.{pause}Their answers reveal coat sorting, food packing, repairs, and cleanup spread across several{pause}rooms under one event name.{pause}The address was incomplete, but the purpose is finally clear enough to guide the last{pause}ladle.

nodes.name: Dom 17
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: At the corridor's end, two final doors stand side by side.{pause}One has a printed 3B label and no sound behind it.{pause}The other says LAUNDRY, but forty volunteers chant SOUP within.{pause}A note under 3B reads SERVICE DRIVE MOVED - ASK THE CLUBS.{pause}Lead Dom can verify the quiet room or trust the crowd.{pause}The pot is lighter now, yet the choice feels heavier.

nodes.name: Dom C1
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: We verify. Good delivery means knowing who still has no bowl.{pause}He knocks twice, waits, then knocks again without retreating.{pause}A sleepy coordinator opens the door amid donated coats.{pause}Six volunteers have been sorting in silence and missed the parade.{pause}Their table holds spoons, labels, and exactly zero food.{pause}The Doms carry in the soup with the careful handoff rhythm.

nodes.name: Dom C2
nodes.speaker: Coordinator
nodes.dialogue: You found the room after everyone else found the smell.{pause}Lead Dom apologizes for serving most lunch in the corridor.{pause}The coordinator says a shared hall was the poorly printed plan.{pause}Second Dom adds a corrected arrow to the lobby map.{pause}Third Dom divides the final loaf into six equal portions.{pause}The volunteers sit, and the room stops feeling forgotten.

nodes.name: Dom C3
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Only one ladle of soup remains after every bowl is full.{pause}Lead Dom serves it over crackers and calls it Essence of Tomato.{pause}The name is ridiculous enough that everyone asks for the recipe.{pause}Second Dom says the secret is three turns and one square wheel.{pause}Third Dom adds that emotional support bread is not optional.{pause}The ending tune swells as the ferret plaque gleams downstairs.

nodes.name: Dom C4
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Delivery complete: warm lunch and zero abandoned rooms.{pause}The report lists one crouton lost and one loaf decorated.{pause}It recommends clearer signs and lids shaped like actual lids.{pause}Lead Dom allows one salute after every bowl is safely parked.{pause}Three Doms salute so hard that the napkin falls off the pot.{pause}Next week, the hall requests them by name for stew logistics.

nodes.name: Dom D1
nodes.speaker: Lead Dom
nodes.dialogue: Laundry Club has the crowd, the tables, and returning bowls.{pause}He declares the room a temporary public soup headquarters.{pause}The yellow-apron volunteer clears the longest table.{pause}Second Dom hangs the NO SALUTING napkin on the clothesline.{pause}Third Dom stacks bread where every group can reach a slice.{pause}The wrong room becomes useful before anyone can call it wrong.

nodes.name: Dom D2
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Laundry baskets become tray stands and socks become table markers.{pause}The chess club numbers bowls with captured score-sheet pencils.{pause}Gardeners garnish the soup with herbs from a windowsill.{pause}Even the puppet heads receive napkins, for unknown reasons.{pause}Lead Dom watches different clubs share one serving line.{pause}The soup parade settles into the liveliest lunch in the building.

nodes.name: Dom D3
nodes.speaker: Volunteer
nodes.dialogue: We were the wrong room until everyone needed a bigger room.{pause}Lead Dom crosses WRONG from his mission report.{pause}He writes UNPLANNED MULTI-CLUB DINING VICTORY instead.{pause}Second Dom leads the Jet Stream bowl return down the table.{pause}Third Dom uses the careful rhythm to pass fresh bread.{pause}Both earlier plans return, working together instead of competing.

nodes.name: Dom D4
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Laundry Club applauds and finds forty matching bowls.{pause}The pot comes back empty and wearing a tiny sock as a lid.{pause}Lead Dom cannot approve the lid, but he cannot improve it either.{pause}The Doms pose beneath the clothesline with the crouton medal.{pause}Next month's invitation says FOLLOW THE SOUP and ROOM: YES.{pause}The wrong-room fanfare returns as every club asks for seconds.
